summary: 135 rows are all publish_attempt events with a maximum amount of 0; no sale event exists anywhere in the recorded ledgers.
A read-only enumeration of the real Gumroad account found 79 live products; one live $99 listing promised 200 verified leads and shipped a one-page description.
17 real (non-dry-run) publish attempts failed; the most recent three failed with HTTP 402 'credits depleted' from the X platform.

One of four live listings serves a different revision than the local canonical product and carries an extra preview artifact; publication was treated as complete at upload time and the artifact was never re-read from the platform.

The module that declares itself the product source of truth omitted the only platform with published products, and its own tests asserted the incomplete total as correct -- self-declared authority is not the same as completeness.

Two product registries disagree in coverage: the declared source of truth holds 21 products while 22 produced assets exist on disk with only 2 mapped between them. Recurrence of the cycle-104 finding, now with a re-runnable count.

Structural QA over 40 artifacts found every file sound, but the Paddle catalogue priced at $126-$388 is backed by 7-22 page documents of 182-2924 extracted words, and one package holds only 182 words across 8 pages. Structural soundness is not depth; the price tier looks unsupported by artifact depth.

The four batch-12 QA failures are structurally intact: their PDFs parse and keep a text layer and their workbooks carry live formulas (3, 10, 1). They fail on depth alone (259-304 words against a 1900-2900 requirement), so the remedy is authored content, not repair.

The price policy counts PDF pages only. B12-006 is a 7-page guide plus a 7-sheet, 111-formula workbook, so the general digital tier caps it at $7.00 while the $29 price is accepted only on the premium curated tier. The workbook - the part a buyer actually uses - is invisible to the ceiling. Same shape already recorded for B12-010's workbook.
